JustFlip! User Manual

JustFlip! looks simple on purpose: a card, a flip, a grade. Underneath are fill-in-the-blank cards, typeset maths, diagrams, spoken hints, Anki import, scheduling priorities, a Watch app and a lot more. This manual walks through all of it — and through the small rules that are easy to trip over.
